description: This Java source file defines a Spring configuration class for inline Close of Business (COB) processing of loans within the Apache Fineract project. It sets up batch job steps, readers, processors, writers, and listeners for the loan COB workflow, including building execution context, processing loans in chunks, resetting context, and handling listeners.

classes.name: LoanInlineCOBConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for inline COB batch processing of loans, including job and step definitions, readers, processors, writers, and listeners.

methods.name: inlineLoanCOBBuildExecutionContextTasklet
methods.description: Creates a tasklet for building the inline COB execution context.

methods.name: inlineCOBBuildExecutionContextStep
methods.description: Defines the step for building the execution context.

methods.name: inlineLoanCOBStep
methods.description: Defines the main COB processing step for loans, processing loan items in chunks.

methods.name: loanInlineCOBJob
methods.description: Defines the batch job to execute the inline loan COB process, chaining context building, processing, and reset steps.

methods.name: inlineCobWorkerItemReader
methods.description: Creates a reader component to fetch loan jobs for COB processing.

methods.name: inlineCobWorkerItemProcessor
methods.description: Creates a processor component to process loan items during COB.

methods.name: inlineCOBResetContextStep
methods.description: Defines the step to reset the execution context after COB processing.

methods.name: inlineCobWorkerItemWriter
methods.description: Creates a writer component to handle the output of COB loan items.

methods.name: inlineCobLoanItemListener
methods.description: Creates an item listener for COB loan item processing events.

methods.name: inlineCOBResetContext
methods.description: Creates a tasklet to reset the COB context.

methods.name: inlineCobPromotionListener
methods.description: Creates a listener to promote specific keys in the execution context for job step communication.
